question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets The Hobbit, Bob gets Middlemarch, and Claire gets Jane Eyre.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Claire and Alice swap books. Then, Claire and Bob swap books. Finally, Claire and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) The Hobbit
(B) Middlemarch
(C) Jane Eyre
solution:
Book order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: The Hobbit | Middlemarch | Jane Eyre
1. Claire and Alice swap: Jane Eyre | Middlemarch | The Hobbit
2. Claire and Bob swap: Jane Eyre | The Hobbit | Middlemarch
3. Claire and Bob swap again: Jane Eyre | Middlemarch | The Hobbit
Claire has The Hobbit, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
